lessons.title: What RAG is, with no jargon
lessons.summary: AI chatbots have never read your documents, and when they do not know something they often make up a confident answer. RAG fixes that by looking up the right paragraph first and handing it to the AI along with the question.

lessons.title: Why AI chatbots make things up
lessons.summary: An LLM writes by picking a likely next word, over and over. It never looks anything up, so when it does not know, it still picks the likeliest sounding word. Putting the real answer in the prompt changes which word is likeliest, which is why RAG works.
